description: Two pairs of LFOs, an X and a Y in each pair, plotted against each other as a Lissajous figure, with their averages, products and ratios on the outputs.

params.text: Sets the peak level of both oscillators of that pair, 0 to 5V.
Sets the rate of the X oscillator of that pair, from one cycle in 256 seconds to 8Hz.
Sets the rate of the Y oscillator of that pair, from one cycle in 256 seconds to 8Hz.
Shifts the start of that pair's X oscillator against its Y oscillator, 0 to 360 degrees.
Bends that X oscillator's wave towards a sine: at 0% it is the skewed ramp, at 100% a sine.
Bends that Y oscillator's wave towards a sine: at 0% it is the skewed ramp, at 100% a sine.
Moves that X oscillator from a falling ramp at 0% through a triangle at 50% to a rising ramp at 100%.
Moves that Y oscillator from a falling ramp at 0% through a triangle at 50% to a rising ramp at 100%.
Sets how much of the voltage at the AMP input changes that pair's level, from full inverted to full; 10V at full covers the whole range.
Sets how much of the voltage at the X FREQ input changes that oscillator's rate, from full inverted to full; at full it is a volt per octave.
Sets how much of the voltage at the Y FREQ input changes that oscillator's rate, from full inverted to full; at full it is a volt per octave.
Sets how much of the voltage at the PHASE input shifts that X oscillator, from full inverted to full; 10V at full is a whole cycle.
Sets how much of the voltage at the X SHAPE input bends that oscillator towards a sine, from full inverted to full.
Sets how much of the voltage at the Y SHAPE input bends that oscillator towards a sine, from full inverted to full.
Sets how much of the voltage at the X SKEW input changes that oscillator's skew, from full inverted to full.
Sets how much of the voltage at the Y SKEW input changes that oscillator's skew, from full inverted to full.

inputs.text: Voltage changing that pair's peak level through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing that X oscillator's rate through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing that Y oscillator's rate through its attenuverter.
Voltage shifting that X oscillator against its Y oscillator, through its attenuverter.
Voltage bending that X oscillator towards a sine, through its attenuverter.
Voltage bending that Y oscillator towards a sine, through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing that X oscillator's skew through its attenuverter.
Voltage changing that Y oscillator's skew through its attenuverter.

outputs.text: The two X oscillators averaged together.
The two Y oscillators averaged together.
The first pair's X divided by the second pair's X, held within -5V to 5V.
The first pair's Y divided by the second pair's Y, held within -5V to 5V.
The two X oscillators multiplied together, which ring modulates one by the other, held within -5V to 5V.
The two Y oscillators multiplied together, which ring modulates one by the other, held within -5V to 5V.
All four oscillators multiplied together, held within -5V to 5V.
